_comment: Publish allowlist for scripts/playground_export_static.py: ONLY these episodes can be exported to the public static site (plg.duetlabs.co / duet-playground.vercel.app). Every entry records the basis for redistributing identifiable participant data. An entry is published when its license is known OR it carries an explicit "approved" record ({by, date YYYY-MM-DD, note}); an UNKNOWN license without approval is refused (override: --allow-unknown-license). attribution and license are shown in the page footer; consent_basis, notes and approved are internal and not published.

eidon_10004.notes: Public dataset recording 10004 (one ego video + 7-slot IMU). The license of eidon-ai/tracker-pov-imu is not recorded in the repo (UNKNOWN). Published since 516ddf3.
